raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100490

Position Overview
Autodesk, Inc., is a leader in 3D design, engineering and entertainment software. Customers across the manufacturing, architecture, building, construction, and media and entertainment industries including the last 16 Academy Award winners for Best Visual Effects use Autodesk software to design, visualize, and simulate their ideas before they're ever built or created.

As a License Compliance Inside Sales Representative you will be responsible for working through a large volume of License Compliance leads and opportunities to vet, drive and close out. You will work closely with Autodesk sales teams (TSR teams), channel partners, legal, and other members of the License Compliance team on compliance matters. The License Compliance Inside Sales Representatives primary activity is discussing the (potential) compliance matter with customers, users and ensuring this leads to a commercial resolution.

A License Compliance Inside Sales Representative is responsible for driving a high level of customer compliance engagements whether warning letters or audit activities, resolving compliance matters while retaining customers. You will also be responsible for meeting, exceeding and forecasting quarterly and annual License Compliance sales goals within your territory.

Responsibilities

  • Work through a large volume of license compliance leads speaking with customers to uncover the compliance issues, ensure customer understands the Intellectual Property or contractual violation at hand, negotiate a resolution and timeline and agree on a commercial closure
  • Communicate directly with customers to negotiate a license compliance settlement value and timeline for purchase
  • Initiate warning letters or audit requests with Autodesk customers and leads customer through the audit process. Presents audit findings to customers and negotiates on the resolution
  • Use Autodesk License Compliance analytics tools and databases to investigate License Compliance prospects
  • Engage customers at the CXO level to gain their cooperation and participation in License Compliance warning letter or audit process
  • Demonstrate the ability to deliver unpopular results and messages as well as handle impassioned discussions and negotiations around non-compliance matters
  • Critical thinking skills to apply Autodesk licensing rules to various customer software deployments
  • Ability to successfully mitigate complex pushback by customers regarding the compliance situation
  • Use Salesforce.com to track all leads, opportunities, activities and results in line with global License Compliance guidelines for closed loop tracking
  • Use lead tracking tools to forecast compliance sales on a regular basis. Utilizes Autodesk customer self-audit process document, targeted account selling, Situational Negotiation Skills and forecasting guidelines to categorize leads according to quality of the lead; accurately forecasts against plans and targets
  • Assist Value Added Resellers in providing customer quotes to satisfy compliance purchases, proposals, order forms and product information
  • Work with Territory Sales for cross-selling or up-selling as appropriate
  • Maintain basic knowledge of Autodesk products, competition and industry trends along with understanding project delivery methods
  • Pro-actively establishes collaborative relationships with territory sales teams engaging them with compliance customers to assemble alternate proposals to resolve compliance issues

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience and comfort with communicating and negotiating at executive level
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written)
  • I.T. Knowledge is an advantage
  • At least 2 years of Inside Sales experience
  • Successful track record in a software sales role is a plus
  • Ideally a previous experience in License compliance
  • Understanding of software licensing models, license agreements and contracts
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Office Products (Excel/Word/Power point)
  • Proficient in utilizing various CRM tools (i.e. Salesforce.com, Siebel, etc)
  • Business English is a must

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Spain based sales roles, we expect a starting On-Target Earnings (OTE) between 57,000 EUR and 83,600 EUR. OTE is comprised of base salary plus commission target for sales roles. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Sales Careers

Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here:


Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:

Job Title: Senior Counsel - Patent Medicinal/Pharmaceutical Chemistry

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Counsel - Patent Medicinal/Pharmaceutical Chemistry

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will work individually and in legal teams and on cross-functional R&D and business teams across various geographies.

This Senior Counsel position can be remotely located, or work from one of these Amgen locations: Thousand Oaks, CA; Cambridge, MA; or South San Francisco (CA).

Responsibilities will include:

  • Working with Amgen scientists to identify patentable subject matter

  • Drafting, filing, and prosecuting patent applications worldwide

  • Conducting prior art searches

  • Analyzing patents and preparing freedom-to-operate opinions

  • Conducting due diligence in support of licensing activities

  • Negotiating and drafting research agreements

  • Providing legal advice and counsel to R&D and business partners on a variety of IP related matters

  • Assisting with litigation-related matters and challenging/defending patents in PTAB, opposition, and other forums.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek has these qualifications.

​

Basic Qualifications

  • J.D. degree or LL.M. degree from an accredited law school, admission to practice law in a U.S. jurisdiction;

and

  • Four plus (4+) years of experience practicing intellectual property law;

and

  • Registered to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ten (10) or more years of experience practicing patent or intellectual property law

  • Experience in all aspects of U.S. and foreign intellectual property law relating to biotechnology at a law firm or biotechnology/pharmaceutical corporation

  • An advanced degree such as a master’s degree or Ph.D. in organic or medicinal chemistry

  • Excellent analytic, legal drafting and oral and written communication skills

  • Strong management and leadership skills as well as a strong client service focus and the ability to work independently and in teams

  • Ability to work efficiently, to prioritize workflow, to meet demanding deadlines, and to manage multi-dimensional projects in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience in U.S. and/or foreign adversarial proceedings (such as patent litigation, Inter Partes Reviews, Post Grant Reviews, and oppositions)

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans

analysts, and business stakeholders.

Leadership.

platforms.

and security.

elements for consistency and ease of use

BI & Reporting QA Testing and Validation:

static/dynamic Power BI reports.

data specs.

JOB PURPOSE

The Category Strategy & Planning (CS&P) organization leads category strategy, channel and customer planning, and category and shopper insights for the U.S. CA&MM (Cooking Aids & Meal Makers business within the Foods Business Unit. This role is a leadership position with responsibility for overseeing Category Strategy & Planning across the Cooking Aids & Mini Meals Portfolio, primarily including Knorr Bouillon, Meal Makers Ready to Heat/ Non Ready to Heat, Soups Gravy and Sauces.

The Category Planning function partners closely with Field Sales, Business Development, Category Strategy, Category Management, Marketing (Demand Creation, Innovation, Shopper,) Finance, Net Revenue Management, Supply Chain, and Trade Marketing to develop a commercial strategy and execution levers via Omni & Pureplay retailer plans through flawless execution that delivers category growth and meets U.S. Cooking Aids & Mini Meals total P&L growth targets..

The Associate Director, Category Strategy & Planning – Cooking Aids & Mini Meals will serve as the voice of the customer and shopper within the cross functional Cooking Aids & Mini Meals leadership team, ensuring channel and customer insights are embedded into short and long term brand and customer commercial plans that align with retailer strategies and deliver profitable growth for both Unilever and its customers.

Find your purpose at Unilever. You will lead innovations, big and small, that will make our business win and grow. You will learn from brilliant business leaders and colleagues in a truly global and diverse culture to ultimately become a better you. If you are driven by commercial acumen, like winning and are passionate about growing categories with customers then this role is just for you.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES:

  • Lead profitable growth for the U.S. CA&MM business, bringing an entrepreneurial, challenger mindset to ignite competitive performance and accelerate category momentum. Output to: In-Year Performance market share assessment, S&OP pacing risk and opportunity
  • Translate data into insight and insight into action by developing and executing robust commercial plans aligned to the Category Growth Strategy and key Category Value Drivers. Output to: Multi-year planning (One Plan), Commercialization input (innovation & PPA)
  • Lead delivery of the out-year plan (partnered with Cat Strat, Marketing) into the annual release of the TCT Materials and annual Foods Summit to launch the next year planning cycle with customers. Output: TCT Materials, Foods Summit
  • Own channel and customer financial delivery, including development of annual growth targets, trade investment budgets, and forecasts that ladder directly to the CA&MM P&L and deliver both top and bottom line KPIs. Output: OP Annual Planning Process
  • Set and deploy channel strategy for the category, ensuring holistic, disciplined customer investment across channels and customers to drive sustainable, profitable growth. Output: Channel Strategy, OP Annual Planning Process
  • Lead deep dive commercial analytics to research and sculpt an approach to address business opportunities such as distribution gaps, in-market execution, competitive dynamics
  • Partner with Net Revenue Management/RGM to deliver optimal pricing/PPA and to optimize promotional effectiveness, delivering stronger ROI and enhancements to in-market execution
  • Serve as the voice of the customer, channel, and shopper within IBP (internal) and JBP (external) processes, while also representing category and brand priorities externally with top strategic customers and internally with Business Development and Category Development Sales teams.
  • Partner closely with field sales and cross functional teams to ensure best in class Perfect Store activation, flawless execution of national cross category and cross customer tentpole programs, and successful innovation launch planning and execution. Processes: MBR input to S&OP, Handshake, Perfect Store

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED
Experiences & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred
  • At least +10 years’ experience in Customer Development, Account Management, Trade Marketing, Category Strategy, and/or Brand Marketing Operations within Consumer Goods industry. Food experience preferred.
  • Results-driven and ownership mindset to achieve set goals and KPIs, highly entrepreneurial
  • Proven ability to demonstrate analytical thinking, data-driven decision making, and ability to influence through strategic story-telling
  • Retail, eCommerce, and Omnichannel customer experience required, high level of CPG Food business industry and retailer acumen
  • Excellent oral/written and presentation skills; ability to tailor communication style across a multitude of disciplines’ leadership levels, executive presence
  • Energized by collaborating with cross-functional partners on new and creative ways to solve business problems; solution-focused mindset
  • Encourages ownership to resolve issues where they are happening. Holds others and organization accountable for delivery.
  • High comfort level using IRI/Nielsen (POS data), Numerator (panel data)

Excellent Team & Organization Leadership Skills:

  • Senior Stakeholder Management & Strategic influencing
  • Talent Catalyst for direct reports
  • Effective mobilizer of cross functional partnerships
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, comfortable adapting to dynamic environments applying mix of personal analysis and delegation
  • Passion for High Performance to over-deliver against assigned targets while managing ambiguity- addressing market volatility with an agile mindset to find creative solutions to achieve results
  • Ability to envision and plan multi-year, understanding long-term and broad-reaching impact of decisions made today. End-to-end process thinking

raw.excerpt: Job SummaryWe are seeking a skilled Data Management and Analytics Support Specialist to support the VHA Specialty Care Program Office in delivering data-driven programmatic insights across the Veterans Health Administration.
raw.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Data Management and Analytics Support Specialist to support the VHA Specialty Care Program Office in delivering data-driven programmatic insights across the Veterans Health Administration. In this role, you will work within an exceptional team within a federal contracting environment to extract, analyze, and interpret complex healthcare data from a wide range of VHA systems and files to inform strategic decision-making and operational improvements. Your vital work will directly contribute to the quality of care and administrative efficiency delivered to our nation's Veterans. The ideal candidate is a highly detail-oriented data professional with deep experience with VHA enterprise systems who thrives in a fast-paced federal healthcare environment and communicates complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A self-starter comfortable working independently while also collaborating across multidisciplinary teams within a complex program office and agency environment will excel in this position.

Primary Responsibilities

Access, query, and extract data from VHA enterprise systems and files including CDW, VistA, VSSC, RAMP, PTF (MedSAS), MCA System, PCMM, NPCD, and the VETSNET Corporate Mini Master File to support programmatic reporting and analysis. Develop and apply advanced computerized models and algorithms to identify, extrapolate, and validate data patterns that support Specialty Care Program Office decision-making and future business trend forecasting. Design and produce clear, accurate data visualizations including graphs, charts, dashboards, and summary reports that translate complex mathematical and statistical information into accessible formats for program managers and leadership. Present analytical findings and data-driven recommendations to program managers and senior stakeholders, advising on how to best adjust business models and operational strategies to achieve favorable programmatic outcomes. Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across multiple VHA data sources by performing routine data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance reviews in support of ongoing and ad hoc reporting requirements. Collaborate with VHA Specialty Care Program Office staff and other stakeholders to define data requirements, document analytical methodologies, and maintain standardized reporting processes in accordance with federal data governance and contracting standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in data management, data analytics, or a closely related field, with demonstrated expertise supporting healthcare or federal government programs, preferably within VA. Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Data Science, Health Informatics, Statistics, Computer Science, Public Health, or a related discipline is required. Master's Degree preferred. In-depth, hands-on knowledge of VHA enterprise systems and files including CDW, VistA, VSSC, RAMP, PTF (MedSAS), MCA System, PCMM, NPCD, and the VETSNET Corporate Mini Master File is required. Must be able to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and comply with all VA information security, privacy, and system access requirements, including completion of required VA cybersecurity training. About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

You will own the systems, processes and frameworks that drive performance across the company. You will lead company-wide OKR planning and review cycles, design scalable performance management processes, analyze organizational data, and ensure our culture and values are consistently reflected in how we hire, evaluate and develop people.

You will work closely with leadership across the business to improve execution, increase accountability and help teams perform at their highest level.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own and continuously improve the company's performance management framework.

  • Lead company-wide OKR planning, tracking and quarterly review cycles.

  • Design and implement scalable people processes that improve organizational effectiveness.

  • Analyze people, performance and operational data to identify trends, measure outcomes and recommend improvements.

  • Build dashboards and reports that provide meaningful insights into organizational performance.

  • Define business requirements for HR systems, reporting tools and workflow automation.

  • Partner with leaders across the company to improve team performance and execution.

  • Develop frameworks for performance reviews, calibration, promotions and career development.

  • Drive initiatives that strengthen accountability, ownership and a high-performance culture.

  • Ensure company values are embedded throughout employee programs, performance evaluations and day-to-day operations.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and improve the employee experience.

  • Support strategic people initiatives and organizational projects as the company grows.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience in People Operations, People Analytics, Organizational Effectiveness, HR Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting or a related field.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into action.

  • Experience designing or improving performance management frameworks, OKRs or organizational processes.

  • Excellent problem-solving and structured thinking skills.

  • Ability to write clear business requirements and improve operational workflows.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.

  • High ownership, attention to detail and a bias toward execution.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

raw.title: Senior QA Automation Developer, Integrations
raw.excerpt: About Us Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish.
raw.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together with CMLS Financial, we form the Nesto Group: more than $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages under management, 1,300+ team members, 12 offices across Canada.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Work Location and Time Zone

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. We strongly prefer candidates who can work Eastern Time hours. If you are based elsewhere in Canada and have worked Eastern hours before, we still want to hear from you.

Why This Role Exists

We're delivering major platform programs for our large enterprise partners. This role is focused on building automation coverage for these initiatives, shaping end-to-end quality as the programs scale.

We already have a strong automation suite and deep in-house expertise at the staff level. This is not a rebuild from zero. It's about taking what works, adapting it to a platform being reshaped for these programs, and wiring it into CI/CD so quality keeps pace with delivery speed. We move fast and iterate, but we don't ship manual workarounds – we invest in repeatable, scalable structure.

You'd be the automation specialist within our delivery team, working closely with our staff automation developers as expert sounding boards, setting the approach and advising us on how this should be done. You can expect roughly a 80/20 split between hands-on coding and collaboration, depending on the project stage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days, a working test automation framework is running, with 60–80% of critical test scenarios automated, running, and actively relied on by the team.
  • Within six months, automation runs in the CI/CD pipeline on pull requests, mirroring what exists for our core platform.
  • You've adapted and extended the existing automation framework rather than rebuilding from scratch – leveraging the suite and expertise already in place.
  • You make sure quality is understood beyond sprint-by-sprint testing, with a focus on ensuring all the pieces work together end to end.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites in Playwright, using design patterns that keep them maintainable over time.
  • Partner with architects, developers, product managers, and our Staff QA Automation Developers across the SDLC – to clarify requirements and define clear acceptance criteria early, and to raise QA practices across the organization.
  • Drive quality across UI and API testing, using monitoring signals, incident reviews, and customer feedback to find improvements.
  • Work with Delivery leadership, stakeholders, and partners to prioritize automation coverage.
  • Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline so coverage runs continuously.
  • Work with product managers to define comprehensive test plans from product and design specifications (URDs, PRDs, HLDs).
  • Play a key role in supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for key projects, for example when we integrate new partners or clients.
  • Leverage AI to speed up how you build and maintain automated tests, then share what works with the team.
  • Own quality beyond test execution – improve processes, documentation, and team workflows, and standardize what works into repeatable practices.
  • Review and run manual test cases in our test management tooling, validate features against test plans, and fold the right scenarios into the automated regression suite.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of QA experience testing SaaS or cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how Quality Engineering fits into development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on test automation framework experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, including authoring and maintaining end-to-end (E2E) test suites.
  • A strong background in TypeScript and/or Go is required, and experience with MySQL or similar relational databases is a plus.
  • An automation-first track record: automated coverage over manual-only QA, with reliability built into the CI/CD pipeline rather than bolted on.
  • Full-stack testing across UI and API layers, including API validation with tools like Postman.
  • Test architecture and scalable design expertise, using patterns such as Page Object Model, data factories, and separation of concerns.
  • Agile fluency, comfort with rapid release cycles, and familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps.
  • Initiative and a point of view. You arrive with a plan rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on AI initiative: you have built agents or applications that made testing meaningfully faster
  • You turn requirements into genuinely useful test coverage, not checkbox test cases
  • Experience with MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, banking, insurance, or other financial services environments

This Role Might Fit You If

  • You have stood up automation from nothing on a program already in flight, and found that energizing rather than daunting
  • You would rather adapt and evolve a working system than rebuild it to your own taste
  • You are comfortable telling leadership "here is what we should do and here is how" early on, not a year in
  • You enjoy being in the room with business and delivery people, not only engineers, and can explain why a test gap matters in business terms
  • You want to shape quality strategy, not only write test code

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a heads-down coding role. If you want to stay out of product and business conversations, this will frustrate you.
  • This is not a role focused mainly on executing manual test cases.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers a reactive, waterfall approach and waits for development to finish before getting involved.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation and doesn't want to improve broader team workflows, documentation, or quality processes.
  • This is not a role for someone who isn't ready to bring AI tools into their daily work.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

You’ll help drive growth by introducing our software to media companies across the country. Your outreach and insights will directly shape Aryeo’s customer base and future success.

raw.description:
The role:

UCT Vocational College launches its first student intake in July 2027, offering occupational qualifications designed to build job-relevant skills and create pathways to employment. We are looking for a Growth Manager to build the growth engine that attracts and converts students to it.

This is a role for a builder. There is no existing funnel to inherit, no channel benchmarks and no conversion baselines – you will create them. You will own how prospective students discover UCT Vocational College, how they move from interest to application, and how many of them are enrolled and paying when the doors open.

You will have support: dedicated data, technology and sales resources, external paid media help, and a marketing team around you. We are also honest that a new institution means a good deal is still being worked out. As an early member of the Vocational College team, you will help shape how its growth and sales function operates, within the commercial priorities, budget and brand parameters agreed with the COO and relevant functional leaders.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

Demand generation

  • Own paid and organic acquisition across search, social and SEO
  • Manage the vocational marketing budget and channel mix, and be accountable for its return on investment
  • Develop creative and messaging briefs in partnership with our marketing and creative teams, and keep a continuous testing programme running
  • Establish the cost and conversion benchmarks we do not yet have

Paid media

  • Set direction for paid media, with day-to-day execution delivered through our digital consultant and delivery partners
  • Own the cost-per-conversion and cost-per-enrolled-student numbers
  • Ensure paid-media campaigns are properly tracked and optimised towards enrolled students rather than raw lead volume

Funnel and conversion

  • Own performance across the full funnel, from first click through to enquiry, application and enrolment
  • Work with our technology team on the website and application portal, shaping the flow, forms and the application journey to improve conversions
  • Find where prospective students drop off, and drive the fixes

Lifecycle marketing and nurture

  • Build the vocational funnel in HubSpot, including lead capture, routing, scoring, pipeline stages and marketing and sales automation
  • Design and build nurture programmes across channels such as email and WhatsApp for a decision cycle measured in months
  • Use AI within the funnel for personalisation, qualification and re-engagement, within our AI and data protection policies
  • Grow and segment the marketing database, ensuring that consent is properly captured and POPIA respected

Working with sales

  • Partner daily with our vocational sales team, and help define what a good lead looks like before anyone is measured on it
  • Ensure acquisition decisions are informed by downstream sales and enrolment outcomes, rather than lead volume alone
  • Establish and act on the lead quality feedback loop

Measurement and reporting

  • Define the tracking, attribution and reporting required to manage performance across the acquisition, sales and enrolment funnel, working with Data and Technology on implementation.
  • Own the commercial assumptions and funnel inputs underpinning the enrolment forecast, working with the Data team to build and monitor it, and drive delivery against the agreed target.
  • Report performance and share what you are learning

Requirements (What you will be expected to know and do):

  • 5+ years in growth, performance or lifecycle marketing, including ownership of a paid budget and accountability for a revenue or enrolment target rather than a lead-volume target
  • Hands-on marketing automation capability, having personally built workflows and nurture programmes in a mature CRM. HubSpot experience is strongly preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of paid media platforms, enough to set direction, audit an account and hold a delivery partner to account
  • Full-funnel experience and the ability to account for what happened after the lead was created
  • Experience owning or closely leading a sales or conversion function, including pipeline management, follow-up processes and accountability for revenue or enrolment outcomes.
  • Practical AI fluency, with examples of how you have applied AI in your own work
  • Comfortable working with engineering and delivery teams, briefing work and holding a quality bar on builds you do not own
  • Sound analytical practice: self-sufficient in CRM reporting, and numerate enough to spot when a number is wrong
  • Structured approach to experimentation and the willingness to stop what is not working
  • Strong written communication and copywriting skills
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to getting things live
  • Knowledge of POPIA and its implications for marketing data and direct communication
  • A degree in Marketing, Business or a related field is preferable. Relevant demonstrable experience will be considered on merit in place of a formal qualification

Advantageous:

  • Experience in education, EdTech or another considered-purchase category with a long decision cycle
  • South African market fluency, including how price sensitivity, payment behaviour and language shape marketing to South African adult learners
  • Experience launching a new brand, product or market
  • Familiarity with the South African qualifications landscape, including QCTO, SAQA and NQF frameworks
  • Hands-on capability in Webflow, Intercom, or landing page and CRO tooling
  • Experience using WhatsApp as a conversion channel in an African market
  • Experience with seasonal or single-intake demand patterns
  • Proficiency in an additional South African official language

Benefits:

  • Family member discount on Valenture Institute programmes
  • Remote working
  • Voluntary savings programme
  • Half-day birthday leave

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive BJAK's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.

What You'll Own

  • Drive strategic execution across AI Neobank priorities. 

  • Build and manage operating rhythm, OKRs, leadership updates, decision tracking and accountability. 

  • Coordinate major workstreams across product, engineering, licensing, market expansion, partnerships, finance and operations. 

  • Prepare concise decision memos, board / leadership materials, execution plans and performance reviews. 

  • Identify gaps, risks and dependencies before they become serious blockers. 

  • Help leadership make sharper trade-offs on people, capital, product and market priorities. 

  • Own special projects that require senior judgement and cross-functional authority.


What We're Looking For 

  • Strong operator with experience driving strategic execution across teams. 

  • Excellent judgement, communication, prioritization and follow-through. 

  • Able to work with founders, CEOs, leadership teams and senior external stakeholders.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity with limited guidance. 

  • Can go from high-level strategy to detailed execution without losing quality. 

  • Strong writing, business analysis and problem-solving skills. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, strategy, operations, fintech, financial services or regional expansion is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Makes the company move faster and with more clarity. 

  • Can challenge, align and unblock teams without adding bureaucracy. 

  • Stays close to facts, numbers, owners and deadlines. 

  • Balances strategic judgement with hands-on execution. 

  • Low ego, high ownership and strong bias for action.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who want a purely advisory role. 

  • Candidates who cannot handle pressure, ambiguity or senior accountability. 

  • People who create process without improving execution. 

  • Those who avoid operational details. 

  • People who prefer status over ownership.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About the Position

Armed with our industry-changing Issues Management platform, our Business Development team is seeking an experienced Senior Sales Executive to drive our market expansion and revenue growth. As a Senior Sales Executive, you will play a critical role in helping potential customers harness the power of our technology and content to transform their businesses. With a deep understanding of complex sales, you will become a trusted strategic partner, leveraging your expertise to guide organizations in navigating risk, opportunity, and uncertainty. Your ability to empathize with customers' challenges and align our solutions to their long-term goals will be instrumental in closing new business opportunities.

About the Business Development Team at FiscalNote

The Business Development Team at FiscalNote serves as the primary touchpoint for our client-focused approach. We are committed to helping our clients identify challenges and providing innovative, data-driven, and practical solutions to better navigate the complexities of their industries. Leveraging our platform of software and information-services products, we empower individuals and organizations with timely and actionable insights. As a member of our Business Development Team, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in a diverse and innovative culture, aligned with our company values and mission. We foster collaboration and success in our modern, open-concept workspace located in downtown Washington D.C. Additionally, we actively engage with and support our community, seeking new opportunities to make a positive impact.

About You

As an experienced Senior Sales Executive, you bring a wealth of knowledge and a track record of success in selling. You possess exceptional empathy, interpersonal skills, and the ability to quickly establish trust with potential customers. Your deep understanding of the sales cycle enables you to identify ideal methods for penetrating accounts ripe for a sale. You recognize that building strong, long-lasting relationships and investing time in developing key accounts are essential for success. Your resilience, competitive nature, and intellectual curiosity drive your continuous personal and professional growth.

What to Expect in This Position

  • Strategically build, manage, and close deals in the sales pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent outreach to prospects and adapt to the unpredictable nature of sales.
  • Meet and exceed quarterly quotas for new business while nurturing ongoing opportunities.
  • Conduct persuasive pitches and product demonstrations to C-level executives, tailoring the business use case based on real-time feedback.
  • Collaborate with internal teams such as ProServ and Client Success to assist in closing deals and leverage marketing material to attract prospects.
  • Engage in collaboration-centric selling with other sales team members to scope, build, and enhance opportunities.
  • Actively participate in industry events to network and stay up-to-date with market trends.

What Sets You Apart

  • Proven track record of at least 5 years in B2B enterprise software or information services sales.
  • Demonstrated success in consultative solutions selling to Fortune 1000 companies.
  • Experience leading impactful demos and delivering compelling pitches to C-level executives.
  • Consistently achieved or surpassed an annual quota of $1 million or more, consistently ranking in the top 20%.
  • Expertise in closing complex sales cycles within competitive markets.
  • Ability to combine professional services with software to create comprehensive solutions.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce is required.
  • Understand how to structure a path to plan to ensure quota achievement.
  • Experience with territory management and partnering with Sales Development Representatives to align outreach.
Excited about this role, but don't meet 100% of the expected qualifications listed above? We'd still love for you to apply!
When applying to FiscalNote, rest assured that your application is reviewed by a living, breathing human being and evaluated based on key competencies needed for success in the position. Our Recruiting team maintains awareness of all open roles which means your application may be assessed against multiple positions and we will reach out to gauge your interest in other opportunities as appropriate. Questions or concerns? Contact @fiscalnote.com, we'd be happy to connect!
As part of FiscalNote's commitment to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with medical conditions or disabilities that will enable their access to the hiring process. If you need an accommodation, please send an email to @fiscalnote.com to let us know the nature of your request.

About FiscalNote

FiscalNote is a leader in policy and global intelligence. By uniquely combining data, technology, and insights, FiscalNote empowers customers with critical insights and the tools to turn them into action.
Home to CQ, FrontierView, VoterVoice, and many other industry-leading brands, FiscalNote helps organizations stay ahead of political and business risk.

At FiscalNote, We Lead with Values

Know your Audience ∙ Find the Truth ∙ Drive Alignment ∙ Level Up ∙ Own the Job ∙ Bias for Action ∙ Support the Family

Company Benefits

FiscalNote supports our people by enabling team members with flexibility and benefits to promote well-being and balance, ensuring all FiscalNoters can bring their authentic selves to work. We start by offering competitive salaries, retirement accounts, and equity packages to ensure we’re all FN owners. Plus, our comprehensive benefits packages align with regional requirements and expectations no matter where you are located across the globe. Learn more at .
FiscalNote values diversity. We are committed to equal opportunities and creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome applicants regardless of ethnic origin, national origin, gender, race, religious beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age. FiscalNote is an EEOC employer.
FiscalNote uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit .

raw.description:
Who we are:

AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions. We equip universities and healthcare providers with the infrastructure needed to expand clinical education across all healthcare disciplines. With partnerships spanning 100+ allopathic (MD), osteopathic (DO), nursing (NP and pre-licensure), PA, and allied health degree programs at 650+ healthcare institutions nationwide and internationally, AMO is solving the healthcare training shortage by enabling quality clinical education at scale.

Since expanding to domestic B2B solutions in 2020, we've secured 75+ partnerships with U.S. academic institutions and placed students in nearly 6,000 clinical rotations. Our proprietary SaaS platform and comprehensive service solutions help schools expand enrollment, open new clinical campuses, and prepare for accreditation visits.

At AMOpportunities, we're guided by a clear set of values that shape how we show up for each other and for those we serve, every day.

  • Trust: Trust the process. Trust one another.
  • Impact: Local focus, global impact. Solutions today for tomorrow.
  • Be a global citizen: Collaborative mindset. Embrace our differences. Work better together.
  • Quality: High quality service. Delighting those we serve.
  • Adapt with Agility: Embrace change. Move fast, stay flexible.
  • Rooted in Relationships: Strong partnerships. Support and celebrate each other. Grow together.

Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. AMOpportunities encourages you to apply even if you do not meet all listed qualifications. We look forward to your application. 

About the position:

The Medical Education – Network Development Coordinator is responsible for building and expanding AMO's national clinical network by identifying, engaging, and developing partnerships with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and healthcare organizations that support clinical education programs.

This is a highly results-driven role designed for professionals who already possess a strong foundation in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, or credentialing and are motivated to make an immediate impact. While AMO provides training on our systems, processes, and platform, successful candidates bring industry knowledge, professional judgment, and the confidence to quickly operate with a high level of independence. This role is remote, but theMedical Education – Network Development Coordinator is expected to collaborate with teammatesvirtually ona regular basis to ensure team goals are met and recruited leads successfully transition into active clinical training sites and preceptor partnerships. The company alsomaintainsan office in Chicago that theCoordinator mayutilizeon an as-needed basis.

The Medical Education – Network Development Coordinator owns a strategic recruitment pipeline from initial outreach through onboarding readiness, balancing relationship-building with measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is driven by thoughtful execution—not simply outreach volume. High performers know how to prioritize opportunities, build trusted relationships, and consistently convert conversations into long-term clinical partnerships that support AMO's continued growth.

This position is best suited for professionals who thrive in an environment built on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, thinking strategically, and delivering measurable results will excel in this role.

 

While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, or Texas.

Essential Functions:

  • Build and expand AMO's clinical network by identifying, engaging, and recruiting physicians, PAs, NPs, and clinical training sites through strategic outreach utilizing email, phone, video, social media, and other communication channels
  • Own a high-volume recruitment pipeline from prospecting through onboarding readiness, prioritizing opportunities effectively while consistently meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly performance expectations
  • Leverage HubSpot and other tech tools to build, prioritize, and manage a strategic outreach pipeline while maintaining accurate documentation, reporting pipeline health, and using data to drive recruitment strategy
  • Apply working knowledge of provider types (MD, DO, PA, NP), clinical specialties, and credentialing requirements—including licensure, board certification, Nursys, NCCPA, and related verification processes—to efficiently qualify prospective partners
  • Educate physicians, advanced practice providers, and healthcare organizations on the value of partnering with AMO to support the next generation of healthcare professionals
  • Guide prospective partners from initial outreach through onboarding readiness while following documented SOPs, maintaining exceptional attention to detail, and exercising sound judgment to resolve issues independently
  • Negotiate educational stipends, collect required contractual and credentialing documentation, and ensure complete, accurate handoffs to internal teams
  • Collaborate closely with Partnerships, Operations, and cross-functional teams to meet school partner needs and placement timelines
  • Communicate professionally and proactively with both external partners and internal stakeholders, leveraging professional networks such as LinkedIn, while ensuring timely follow-up and exceptional customer experience
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruitment strategies, outreach effectiveness, and internal processes while maintaining consistency with established workflows
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills, Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, credentialing, or a related healthcare field strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding either KPIs, quotas, or performance metrics in a goal-oriented environment, or deadlines in a clinical education environment
  • Experience working with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and/or healthcare organizations preferred
  • Strong understanding of provider credentialing processes, including licensure verification, board certification, Nursys, NCCPA, and related healthcare documentation
  • Experience managing CRM-based recruitment or business development pipelines; HubSpot experience strongly preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence healthcare professionals, navigate objections, and build long-term professional relationships. Comfortable with utilizing professional networks and social presence (LinkedIn) to generate opportunities
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and consistently execute documented processes while exercising sound judgment and independent decision-making
  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives, adapt to changing placement needs, and maintain urgency without sacrificing accuracy
  • High level of professionalism, accountability, and ownership with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where individual performance directly contributes to team success

What You Gain:

  • Competitive base salary of $65,000 to $75,000 annually, and bonus structure tied to the achievement of KPIs and revenue goals.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Program: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Tax Exempt Student Loan Repayment, and Commuter Benefits
  • A mission-driven work environment committed to a spirit of support, growth, and achievement
  • Performance-based career growth opportunities
  • A front-row seat for the exponential growth of a booming education tech company
  • Work/life balance

Equal Opportunity Employer

At AMOpportunities we champion the reality of diversity and the necessity of inclusion and accessibility. We are deeply committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, and to providing our employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment based on disability, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy status (including childbirth and related states), sexual orientation, race, color, social or ethnic origin, religion, age, HIV status, past/present military service, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

AMOpportunities manages our business remotely, unless otherwise stated. This is inclusive of interviewing, onboarding, and each role day to day. Please consider that our roles are hybrid with options to work at our River North Office.

raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Exterro is seeking a dynamic and motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing SaaS company. As a BDR, you will be the first point of contact for potential clients, playing a crucial role in driving the company’s growth by identifying new opportunities, qualifying leads, and supporting the sales team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a driven individual to build their career in sales and technology within a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Location/Hours:This role is a permanent work from home position, and we are currently accepting applications from candidates who reside in the US Central & Mountain Time Zones.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Generation and Prospecting:

  • Identify and research potential clients and key decision-makers using tools such as LinkedIn, Salesforce, etc.
  • Initiate contact with prospects through cold calls, marketing events, emails, and social media outreach.
  • Develop and maintain a territory pipeline of qualified leads.
  • Meet and/or exceed individual quota, responsible to stay targeted to metrics.
  • Meet weekly KPIs: cold calls, emails, LinkedIn messages, etc.

Qualifying Leads:

  • Assess the suitability of prospects based on predefined qualification criteria (BANT).
  • Schedule meetings for the sales team with qualified leads.

Relationship Building:

  • Build rapport with potential clients by understanding their industry challenges and offering tailored solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects, ensuring a positive and professional experience providing product information and success stories.

Collaboration with Sales and Marketing:

  • Work closely with the sales team to ensure a seamless handoff of qualified leads.
  • Provide feedback to the marketing team regarding the effectiveness of campaigns and lead quality.
  • Stay aligned with sales targets and company objectives.

Data Management and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date lead records, activity and reporting in the CRM system (Salesforce)
  • Track and report on key performance metrics, such as outreach volume, conversion rates, and pipeline growth.
  • Analyze and refine outreach strategies to improve effectiveness.

Requirements:

  • 1-2 years of experience in a B2B sales, lead generation or customer facing role (preferably in the SaaS industry).
  • Proficient with modern sales tech stack: Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, AI Tools, etc.

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) / Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Job Summary

The Chief Cost Optimization Officer (CCOO) is responsible for driving enterprise-wide cost efficiency, productivity improvement, and sustainable expense management. This role leads initiatives to optimize operating costs while maintaining service quality, regulatory compliance, and business performance.

The CCOO partners with executive leadership to identify cost-saving opportunities, streamline processes, and embed a culture of financial discipline and operational efficiency across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cost Strategy & Optimization

Develop and execute a comprehensive cost optimization strategy aligned with business goals

Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities across all business units

Drive sustainable cost reduction without compromising service quality

Establish cost governance frameworks and policies

2. Expense Management & Control

Monitor operating expenses (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX)

Implement cost controls, budgeting discipline, and expense tracking mechanisms

Analyze cost drivers and recommend corrective actions

Improve cost transparency and reporting

3. Process Improvement & Efficiency

Identify inefficiencies and streamline business processes

Lead lean transformation, automation, and digital initiatives

Improve productivity and operational efficiency

Standardize processes across departments

4. Data Analytics & Performance Monitoring

Use data analytics to identify cost-saving opportunities and inefficiencies

Develop dashboards and KPIs to track cost performance

Conduct benchmarking against industry standards

Provide insights and recommendations to executive leadership

5. Vendor & Procurement Optimization

Oversee vendor management and procurement strategies

Negotiate contracts to achieve cost savings

Optimize supplier relationships and sourcing strategies

Implement cost-effective procurement processes

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with finance, operations, HR, IT, and business units

Ensure alignment between cost initiatives and business strategy

Support strategic initiatives with cost-benefit analysis

Drive organization-wide accountability for cost management

7. Governance & Compliance

Ensure cost optimization initiatives comply with regulatory requirements

Maintain strong internal controls and audit readiness

Align cost strategies with risk management frameworks

Monitor and report on cost-related risks

8. Leadership & Culture Building

Lead cost optimization and transformation teams

Promote a culture of cost awareness and accountability

Drive change management initiatives

Support talent development and succession planning

Education

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in finance, operations, consulting, or cost management roles

Proven experience in senior leadership roles focused on cost optimization, transformation, or operational efficiency

Strong background in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Strong financial and analytical skills

Expertise in cost management, process improvement, and operational efficiency

Knowledge of financial services regulations and industry practices

Strategic thinking and problem-solving ability

Leadership and change management skills

Data-driven decision-making

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Reduction in operating costs (OPEX)

Cost-to-income ratio improvement

Efficiency gains and productivity metrics

ROI on cost optimization initiatives

Vendor cost savings and procurement efficiency

Compliance and audit outcomes

Preferred Attributes

Experience in digital transformation, automation, or lean methodologies

Exposure to large-scale or multinational financial institutions

Strong collaboration with cross-functional teams

Ability to lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives tied to cost savings and efficiency gains

Executive benefits and allowances
