Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
  • Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
  • Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

As an Android Software Engineer, you own the Android client experience, how AI feels, behaves, and performs on mobile devices. This is not a thin client role. You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter.

Focus

  • Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows.

  • Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior.

  • Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments.

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs).

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow).

  • Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Comfort building in environments with latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic behavior.

  • Experience with MLKit or light on-device inference.

  • Published production apps on the Google Play Store.

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use android applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin / Java

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role:

An eBay subsidiary, TCGplayer is on a quest to be the most trusted trading card game (TCG) platform — connecting and empowering the hobby community. Trading card games are a $25B global market that creates community connection through in-person games (Pokemon; Magic: The Gathering; YuGiOh; etc.). Founded by TCG enthusiasts, we operate a global marketplace, and create tools, technologies and solutions that help small businesses profitably sell TCGs at scale.

As a Principal Product Designer, Design Systems, you will shape the future of TCGplayer's product experience by evolving the shared design system that powers our end-to-end commerce ecosystem—from marketplace experiences and seller tools to fulfillment and robotic inventory digitization systems. You will establish and continuously elevate the visual language, interaction patterns, and experience standards that define our products, helping transform them into cohesive, intuitive, and professional-grade experiences that reflect the quality of an eBay company. Working at the intersection of design, engineering, and technology, you will create the shared foundation that enables teams to deliver exceptional user experiences with greater speed, consistency, and quality while advancing AI-assisted design and development through modern design systems, design tokens, and code-connected workflows.

Our User Experience Design team prides itself on creating a culture that fosters camaraderie, embraces diversity, and exudes passion. We value curiosity, craft, and a desire to directly interact with the real world. You don’t have to be a hobbyist or gamer to love working in TCGplayer’s UX Design organization, but you should be eager to amplify our steadfast commitment to making hobbies and games accessible, fun, and rewarding for everyone. If you’re equal parts “empathy” and “ambition,” this is an opportunity to take risks and stretch yourself, surrounded by teammates who will support you along the way.

What you will accomplish:

  • Own and evolve TCGplayer's design system across our commerce ecosystem, establishing the visual language, interaction patterns, and reusable components that power consistent, high-quality products.

  • Partner closely with Design and Engineering to ensure the design system is implemented consistently across both Figma and code, improving quality, maintainability, and development efficiency.

  • Define and maintain design standards, governance, documentation, and contribution models that enable the system to scale as the organization grows.

  • Advance our design tooling by developing and maintaining component libraries, design tokens, variables, and workflows that improve designer productivity and implementation fidelity.

  • Raise the quality bar across the organization by evolving our visual language, accessibility standards, and UX patterns based on a deep understanding of our customers’ unique needs.

  • Partner with UX Design and Product teams on strategic roadmap initiatives, design sprints, and vision work to define new interaction patterns and experience frameworks that solve emerging customer needs and evolve the design system through practical application in shipped products.

  • Champion modern design and development workflows, including AI-assisted design and design-to-code capabilities, ensuring our design system is prepared for the future of product development.

What you will bring:

  • 8+ years of experience in Product, UX, Visual, or Experience Design, including significant experience designing and evolving enterprise-scale design systems for complex digital products.

  • Demonstrated expertise in design systems architecture, including component libraries, design tokens, variables, interaction patterns, documentation, governance, and scalable contribution models.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to create elegant, intuitive, and highly polished product experiences while translating them into reusable system assets.

  • Familiarity with emerging AI-assisted design and design-to-code workflows, and a strong interest in shaping how design systems enable the future of product development.

  • Experience designing for desktop, responsive web, and native mobile experiences, with the ability to create scalable patterns that work cohesively across platforms.

  • Deep understanding of how design systems are implemented in code, with experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure consistency between design and production through shared components, tokens, and front-end technologies.

  • Ability to define and evolve design languages, interaction models, and UX standards that improve product quality, consistency, accessibility, and efficiency across multiple products and teams.

  • Experience establishing new interaction patterns and translating innovations from product work into scalable design system capabilities that can be adopted across an organization.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance immediate product needs with long-term platform health, maintainability, and scalability.

  • Experience with modern design tooling including Figma component libraries, variables, design tokens, and prototyping, with a passion for improving how designers and engineers work together.

  • Outstanding communication and facilitation skills, with a proven track record of building alignment across Design, Product, and Engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, seller tools, SaaS, fintech, or other complex product ecosystems

  • Demonstrated experience implementing AI-assisted design and development workflows, including integrating design systems with AI-powered prototyping, design generation, and design-to-code pipelines

  • Familiarity with the gaming, hobby, or collectibles community — particularly trading card games

$127,600 - $214,700

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Candidates must be current employees of the SANS Institute to be eligible for this position.

About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You'll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Senior Student Advisor to join our SANS Technology Institute team. This role plays a key part in

providing leadership and mentorship to a small team of student advisors. This role manages a caseload of students while also supporting the Assistant Director with program services and initiatives, retention efforts, and training of new advisors. The Senior Student Advisor plays a crucial role in onboarding new hires, providing second-line retention support, and answering daily questions from their teammates.

As a Senior Student Advisor, you will:

  • Mentorship & Team Support
    • Provide leadership and mentorship to a small team of student advisors, ensuring they are equipped to support students effectively.
    • Answer daily questions on Slack or other communication platforms to support advisors in their roles.
    • Assist in the onboarding, mentorship, and training of new advisors, assessing their readiness to work independently.
    • Handle complex student concerns and escalate cases as needed, serving as the primary point of support before issues reach the Assistant Director.
  • Student Advising & Retention Support
    • Offer general and specialized advising to students enrolled in SANS.edu programs, monitoring academic progress and coaching students toward success.
    • Maintain regular communication with students regarding their academic progress, course requirements, and program completion plans.
    • Provide responsive, timely, and accurate service to students.
    • Identify obstacles affecting student success and provide actionable recommendations and/or referrals.
    • Assist the Assistant Director of Advising by providing second-line retention support, conducting outreach to at-risk students, and helping implement intervention strategies.
    • Manage student enrollments using SANS.edu systems, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
  • Contributions to Team Development & Training
    • Assist in developing and refining advising processes and student support strategies to improve student engagement and retention.
    • Identify areas for improvement in advising workflows and propose solutions to enhance efficiency.
    • Contribute to staff meetings and training sessions, sharing best practices and process improvements.
    • Help maintain a positive and collaborative advising culture, fostering a team environment that enhances student support.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional advising experience, preferably in a higher education setting
  • Strong understanding of institutional values, curriculum, policies, procedures, and resources
  • Demonstrated leadership and mentorship experience, particularly in a remote setting
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in using discretion and good judgment in all student interactions
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing to a collaborative team
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Proficiency in student engagement strategies and retention practices
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Master’s degree
  • Experience with Canvas, Salesforce, or other higher education platforms
  • Experience using proactive, developmental and/or appreciative advising approaches

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $65,000- $70,000, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

You’reRGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

The Principal Databricks Architect will shape and scale our Databricks-based data science and AI platform, and to lead where our practice is heading: a governed, self-service environment that lets data science teams move from idea to production with minimal friction. As the technical leader of the platform, this individual brings design thinking to mature the platform as a product—designing reusable capabilities, patterns, and guardrails that empower actuarial, data science, and analytics teams to independently develop, train, deploy, and operate models and AI agents. The ideal candidate pairs deep architectural expertise with a strong enablement mindset, engaging directly with diverse data science communities to understand their workflows and remove barriers to adoption. They will modernize our platform around the latest Databricks capabilities—Unity Catalog governance, Mosaic AI and Agent Bricks, Genie, Lakeflow, and Lakebase—while ensuring interoperability with our Snowflake enterprise data platform through open formats such as Apache Iceberg. This is a highly visible role that sets technical direction, champions frictionless developer experience, enforces least-privileged access and data governance, and enables global, cost-efficient deployment of AI in compliance with data sovereignty requirements.

Principle Duties

  • Platform Vision & Architecture: Define and champion the end-to-end architecture for the Databricks data science and AI platform across a global topology — ensuring scalability, security, cost efficiency, resilience, and compliance with regional data sovereignty laws. Establish reference architectures, patterns, and blueprints that encourage enterprise-wide reuse and standardization.

  • Governance & Compliance: Lead the design and adoption of Unity Catalog as the central governance plane—defining catalog hierarchies, fine-grained (row/column) access, dynamic data masking, lineage, and classification. Partner with infrastructure, security, and compliance teams to enforce least-privileged access, responsible AI, and regulatory requirements including data sovereignty across US, EMEA, and APAC.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

raw.excerpt: About ProductVyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management.
raw.description:
About Product

VyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management. Built on Linux, VyOS integrates powerful routing, firewall, VPN, and network services into a unified system. Unlike traditional networking hardware, VyOS can be deployed on a wide range of platforms, from physical routers and cloud environments to virtual machines, giving users flexibility and control over their network infrastructure.

The key strength of VyOS lies in its comprehensive feature set. It supports dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP), multiple VPN types (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard), firewall rules, traffic shaping, and more - all configured through a unified command-line interface (CLI) familiar to network engineers. Its ability to scale across various environments makes it popular with organizations seeking open-source networking solutions.

Job description

The Network Support Engineer is responsible for developing, validating, and optimizing VyOS networking solutions to ensure performance, stability, and usability. This role involves designing Proof of Concept (PoC) scenarios, testing new features, troubleshooting complex issues, and maintaining technical documentation. The Network Engineer will work closely with developers, support teams, and external partners to enhance VyOS compatibility and functionality across diverse network environments.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new features and optimize existing code for VyOS, ensuring efficient and maintainable implementations.
  • Collaborate with developers to review and validate code changes, test feature implementations, and provide feedback on bugs, optimizations, and feature proposals.
  • Create technical content, including solution briefs, datasheets, and graphical materials, tailored to address specific networking use cases and technical requirements.
  • Design, deploy, and configure network infrastructures using VyOS and other networking equipment to meet project objectives and performance standards.
  • Design and deploy PoC scenarios using VyOS, documenting configuration setups, performance benchmarks, and solution viability for customer-specific requirements.
  • Diagnose and resolve network performance, security, and connectivity issues, utilizing advanced debugging and analysis tools.
  • Investigate escalated technical issues, conduct root cause analysis, and deliver reproducible solutions or detailed technical reports for development resolution.
  • Conduct functional, performance, and regression testing for VyOS features and fixes, creating and maintaining detailed test documentation.
  • Develop and manage automated test frameworks for repetitive test cases, enhancing testing accuracy and efficiency.
  • Enhance testing methodologies by introducing advanced tools and frameworks to optimize validation processes and outcomes.
  • Conduct interoperability testing with third-party systems to ensure seamless integration of VyOS into diverse networking environments.
  • Maintain a centralized knowledge base with detailed, technically accurate articles and solution documentation to support internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements

Skills

  • Strong understanding of networking protocols such as BGP, OSPF, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Hands-on experience with VyOS or other open-source networking platforms.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Bash for automation and testing.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities in complex network environments.
  • Experience with network performance tuning and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with software-defined networking (SDN) and cloud networking principles.
  • Ability to develop and execute test cases for network functionality and performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and collaboration.
  • Strong ability to analyze packet captures, system logs, and debugging outputs.
  • Japanese conversational level

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in networking, system administration, or network security.
  • Experience working with VyOS, open-source network operating systems, or enterprise-grade networking solutions.
  • Prior experience in feature validation, troubleshooting, and debugging network-related issues.
  • Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, KVM, Hyper-V) and cloud networking (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience conducting Proof of Concept (PoC) demonstrations and documenting technical findings.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks for networking products.

Work Conditions and Compensation

Fully Remote Work:This 100% remote position allows you to work anywhere.

Flexible Work Schedule:We offer a flexible work schedule that allows you to manage your time while ensuring effective collaboration across our globally distributed teams. The official workday starts between 8 AM and 11 AM (employee local time) and ends between 5 PM and 8 PM (employee local time). While flexibility is encouraged, occasional work outside typical hours may be required to align with colleagues in different time zones. Open communication and availability for cross-time-zone meetings are essential for seamless teamwork.

Time Tracking:Employees are required to use time tracker software to monitor working hours and productivity.

Vacation:Enjoy 20 days of annual paid vacation

National Holidays:You are entitled to up to 10 days of paid leave for recognized national holidays.

Sick Leave: is provided in accordance with company policy

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a company dedicated to creating cutting-edge, open-source network solutions that empower organizations to manage their networks with flexibility and control. As the company behind the VyOS network operating system, we are committed to delivering a robust, scalable, and secure platform that meets the diverse needs of businesses, service providers, and network professionals worldwide.

At VyOS Networks, our work goes beyond just providing technology - we’re shaping the future of networking with a global, community-driven project. We foster an environment where talented individuals come together to solve complex networking challenges, while continuously improving both our products and ourselves.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

About Packback

Packback is an AI-powered learning platform used by 2,000–3,000 professors across the country to drive deeper student engagement and critical thinking. Our professors don't just use Packback — many of them love it, talk about it, and champion it to their peers. We're looking for someone to turn that energy into a structured, scalable growth engine.

The Role

This is a newly created role with a clear commercial mandate: own the professor advocate community and turn it into a source of pipeline, proof, and brand credibility. You'll build the program from the ground up — identifying our best advocates, giving them identity and belonging, and activating them across referrals, case studies, thought leadership, and social content.

You'll sit at the intersection of Marketing and Customer Success, reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing, and will collaborate closely with Sales to build scalable programs that deepen customer engagement, elevate customer voices, and support long-term customer growth and retention.

This role comes with real autonomy to build advocacy from scratch, and because you're joining a lean team, you'll also have visibility into and occasional hands-on involvement in broader marketing execution like webinars and launches.

What You'll Own

Customer Advocacy + Community

  • Design and launch a named professor advocate program to identify, engage, and activate customer champions
  • Build segmented advocate pools reflecting how professors engage with Packback — as individual adopters or as part of a broader institutional relationship — with tailored engagement for each
  • Maintain an advocate database with engagement history, content consent, and referral status
  • Manage ongoing communication with the advocate community (newsletters, spotlights, exclusive previews, appreciation initiatives)
  • Assist in planning and management of Customer Advisory Board programs and other customer-focused events, including recruitment, communications, meetings, and follow-up activities.

Case Studies & Customer Evidence

  • Oversee creation of customer case studies, testimonials, video interviews, customer-generated content, and pull quotes for decks and proposals
  • Own the end-to-end case study pipeline — identification, outreach, interview, production, approval, and distribution planning
  • Drive review generation and online reputation initiatives to enhance brand credibility, and monitor and respond to reviews, using feedback to improve advocate experience

Referrals & Sales Enablement

  • Develop a structured referral program that converts professor goodwill into warm introductions for the sales team
  • Build a library of approved references, peer testimonials, and name-drop lists for sales cycles
  • Ensure Sales has the right professor reference, case study, or peer testimonial ready at the specific stage of the deal where it removes friction
  • Package customer outcomes into assets that speed up sales cycles and support retention

Thought Leadership & Social Activation

  • Identify professors willing to speak at ed-tech conferences, contribute to webinars, or write guest content
  • Activate advocates on LinkedIn and other channels — co-creating content, sharing wins, and amplifying Packback's brand
  • Build a speaker roster for events and panel opportunities

Customer Engagement

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive customer engagement, product awareness, and adoption programs
  • Lead customer communications that reinforce product value including webinars, newsletters, and educational content
  • Gather and communicate customer insights to inform marketing, product, and customer experience strategies
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention

How Success Is Measured

  • Advocate count and tier distribution
  • Referral volume and conversion rate
  • Case study pipeline and production velocity
  • Influenced closed-won revenue
  • Review volume and score
  • Social share metrics
  • Reported monthly to leadership as commercial outcomes attributed to advocacy

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, or community programs in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated track record of building advocacy programs that produced measurable commercial outcomes (pipeline, referrals, case studies)
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills - professors are busy, skeptical of "marketing," and respond to genuine connection over transactional asks
  • Strong storytelling instincts to turn a customer outcome into a compelling narrative, guide its development, and ensure it lands with the right audience
  • High ownership and comfortable with sales-adjacent metrics to work successfully hand-in-hand with a revenue team
  • Analytical mindset with ability to track performance and derive actionable insights.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage a large portfolio of relationships and concurrent projects

Nice to Have

  • Experience in edtech or selling to academic institutions
  • Familiarity with advocacy platforms (e.g., Orca, Influitive, ReferenceEdge)
  • Experience with LinkedIn content strategy and thought leadership programs
  • Background in community management or event production
  • Experience leveraging AI tools as a force multiplier

Additional Information:

Sponsorship: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without the need for sponsorship. Packback does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Location: Currently we are only able to hire from these states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MD, MI, NJ, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI

Salary: Base salary range of $85,000–$100,000 with an annual bonus target of 10%

Benefits

Why work at Packback?

Build a meaningful career while building the future of education as a part of a company culture that fosters the growth, safety, and creativity of its employees.

Intentional Culture

Packback knows that the single most important part of any company is its people. We take building and maintaining a conscious and intentional culture of open communication, curiosity, and leadership extremely seriously. We collectively commit to make Packback a safe environment where people can focus on doing great work instead of dealing with drama.

Career Development

Packback’s career development paths present a unique balance between clarity and guidance around defined paths, and room for our team to create their own path. Each team has its own career development tracks with support and training, and still allow for customization of these paths to create a role where a team member’s full passions and abilities are put to use!

Thoughtful Benefits

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

This is a paid freelance, remote position.

Polygon is a leading digital publication covering gaming, entertainment, and culture, serving millions of readers with smart, authoritative stories on the biggest video games, releases, franchises, industry developments, and conversations shaping gaming culture. With a focus on quality, timeliness, and relevance, we aim to be a go-to destination for passionate gaming fans and curious newcomers alike.

We're looking for passionate and knowledgeable freelance Gaming Writers who can create timely, engaging content around the biggest stories, releases, trends, and conversations in the gaming industry. This role goes beyond writing articles — it's about connecting with a dedicated gaming audience and driving meaningful readership through insightful, relevant content.

Your Responsibilities

  • Monitor gaming news cycles, new releases, trending topics, and community conversations to surface timely content opportunities.
  • Research and write engaging, accurate articles covering the games, franchises, and stories that matter to Polygon's audience.
  • Identify compelling angles around breaking news, industry developments, emerging trends, and gaming culture.
  • Work closely with editors to align coverage with editorial priorities and publishing schedules.
  • Work independently while consistently meeting deadlines.
  • Ensure timely publication of relevant content aligned with SEO and audience engagement goals.
  • Follow Polygon's editorial, style, and formatting guidelines rigorously.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote — write from wherever you'd like!
  • Opportunities to pitch original ideas.
  • Flexible freelance schedule.
  • Consistent and timely payments.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a leading gaming and entertainment publication.
  • An amazing community of like-minded people to nerd out with on a daily basis.

Experience and Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience in digital journalism or online publishing.
  • Ability to independently research, write, and submit clean, accurate content on tight deadlines.
  • Strong knowledge of the gaming industry, including major franchises, platforms, developers, publishers, and current releases.
  • Strong understanding of gaming culture, internet trends, memes, and online communities.
  • Ability to identify stories and angles with strong audience potential.
  • Passion for video games, entertainment, and digital storytelling.
  • Familiarity with SEO best practices and headline strategy.
  • Experience working with CMS tools.

​

How to Apply

If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

  • Your CV
  • A sample article similar in nature to the content published on Polygon.

Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Please note that a writing evaluation may be required as part of our application process.

​

Polygon is part of the Valnet Publishing Group.

Valnet, founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.

Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence.

raw.title: Senior BOP Underwriter
raw.excerpt: About weSureAt weSure, we're reimagining small business insurance by making commercial coverage simpler, more accessible, and more transparent.
raw.description:
About weSure

At weSure, we're reimagining small business insurance by making commercial coverage simpler, more accessible, and more transparent.

Our digital-first platform combines technology, data, and advanced underwriting to make it easier for small business owners and agents to get the coverage they need. We focus on the unique needs of small businesses across industries including restaurants, retail, professional services, contractors, real estate, healthcare, and more.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior BOP Underwriter to help us build and manage a profitable commercial insurance portfolio.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Business Owners Policy (BOP) Underwriter with a strong background in commercial lines and small business insurance.

This is a senior-level role for an underwriting professional who can independently evaluate risks, make sound underwriting decisions, structure coverage, develop pricing, and manage a profitable book of business.

The ideal candidate combines deep BOP underwriting expertise with strong analytical judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to work effectively with agents and brokers.

You will also have the opportunity to contribute to underwriting strategy and help shape processes in a technology-driven insurance environment.

What You'll Do

Underwriting & Risk Selection

  • Evaluate BOP and small commercial submissions across a broad range of industries.
  • Analyze applications, loss runs, financial information, inspections, and supplemental underwriting documentation.
  • Assess property, general liability, business income, equipment breakdown, cyber, crime, and other commercial exposures.
  • Evaluate catastrophe exposures, including wind, hail, flood, wildfire, and earthquake.
  • Determine account eligibility based on underwriting guidelines, risk appetite, and portfolio objectives.
  • Identify adverse selection, emerging risks, and trends that may impact profitability.

Pricing & Coverage

  • Develop appropriate pricing based on risk characteristics, loss experience, and market conditions.
  • Determine premiums, deductibles, limits, endorsements, and exclusions.
  • Review replacement cost valuations and business income calculations.
  • Apply sound underwriting judgment while balancing growth and profitability.
  • Negotiate terms and conditions with agents and brokers.

Portfolio Management

  • Manage and maintain a profitable book of commercial business.
  • Monitor loss ratios, retention, growth, and agency performance.
  • Conduct renewal reviews and identify opportunities for account expansion.
  • Identify underperforming segments and recommend corrective actions.
  • Contribute to strategies that support profitable premium growth.

Agency & Broker Relationships

  • Build strong relationships with independent agents, brokers, and key producers.
  • Provide underwriting guidance and product expertise.
  • Help agents structure accounts appropriately and improve submission quality.
  • Participate in agency meetings and business planning discussions.
  • Serve as a trusted underwriting resource for agency partners.

Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior underwriting professionals.
  • Contribute to underwriting strategy, product development, and portfolio initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve underwriting processes and decision-making.
  • Stay current on commercial insurance trends, regulatory developments, and emerging risks.
  • Support quality assurance, compliance, and underwriting governance.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Drive profitable growth within your assigned book and territory.
  • Maintain targeted loss ratios and retention levels.
  • Deliver timely and accurate underwriting decisions.
  • Strengthen agency relationships and improve submission quality.
  • Identify emerging risks and recommend appropriate underwriting actions.
  • Contribute to underwriting strategy and process improvement.
  • Become a trusted technical resource for the underwriting team.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of commercial lines underwriting experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on BOP underwriting experience.
  • Proven experience managing a profitable commercial book of business.
  • Strong background in small commercial insurance and/or middle-market risks.
  • Experience working directly with independent agents and wholesale brokers.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and liability coverages.
  • Excellent risk selection and underwriting judgment.
  • Strong analytical and financial assessment skills.
  • Ability to independently make and defend underwriting decisions.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

Technical Expertise

Experience with:

  • Business Owners Policies (BOP)
  • Commercial General Liability (CGL)
  • Commercial Property
  • Business Income & Extra Expense
  • Equipment Breakdown
  • Cyber Liability
  • Crime Coverage
  • Inland Marine
  • EPLI
  • Hired & Non-Owned Auto
  • Umbrella / Excess Liability
  • ISO forms and rating methodologies
  • Commercial underwriting and policy administration systems
  • Risk modeling and predictive analytics
  • Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Insurance, Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • CPCU, AU, CIC, ARM, or another relevant insurance designation.
  • Experience with portfolio optimization, book roll analysis, and renewal strategies.
  • Experience mentoring junior underwriting professionals.
  • Experience working in a technology-enabled, digital, or data-driven insurance environment.

Benefits

Why Should You Choose a Career with weSure?

Making a Real Difference

At weSure, we’re dedicated to today’s small businesses. And when you work with us, you’ll be providing these hard-working individuals with the protection they need to secure their future, and build their dreams from the ground up.

Fostering the Future

When you join weSure, you’re playing an integral part in the next generation of business insurance, helping us deliver simple, transparent and effective policies with the click of a button.

Total Freedom

A career at weSure gives you the freedom to work, develop and thrive from the comfort of anywhere. We value every single one of our employees’ time and energy, and believe nobody can be truly successful, without a healthy work-life balance.

A Family of Support

We see our team members as part of our larger, connected family — no matter where they are in the world. We’re always available to provide the support, guidance and resources you need to achieve your best.

A Challenging Atmosphere

At weSure, no day is like any other. You will constantly be faced with exciting issues and ever-changing challenges that will always keep you engaged, inspired, and operating at the top of your game.
