Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Legion Health is seeking clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to collaborate with and supervise PMHNPs through secure telehealth workflows. This nationwide, remote, part-time contractor opportunity combines predictable flexibility with meaningful clinical responsibility and the support of a modern clinical organization.

Legion recruits and vets the PMHNPs and manages the operational infrastructure, while you provide responsive clinical guidance, chart review, mentorship, and independent prescribing decisions when legally permitted and clinically appropriate.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Part-time

  • Compensation: $50K-150K per year, depending on the number and workload of PMHNPs supervised

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

SME Implementation Group (SMEIG) seeks new members to join in 2027

The Trustees of the IFRS Foundation (Trustees) invite candidates to apply for membership of the SME Implementation Group (SMEIG).

The two main responsibilities of the SMEIG are:

  1. to support the use of the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard by:
    • considering questions on its implementation and application;
    • using set criteria to decide which questions merit published educational material; and
    • developing, on a timely basis, questions and answers (Q&As) that are made publicly available.
  2. to consider the need to amend the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard and to make recommendations to the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) on:
    • issues related to the implementation and application of the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard that cannot be addressed by Q and
    • new and amended IFRS Accounting Standards that have been approved since the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard was issued or last amended.

The terms of reference and operating procedures for the SMEIG are available on the IFRS Foundation’s website.

Members of the SMEIG are selected for their knowledge of and experience in financial reporting by small and medium-sized entities (SMEs) and, preferably, their knowledge of and direct experience with the IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard.

The Trustees aim to balance the geographical representation of the Group and are particularly interested in:

  1. candidates from Asia; or
  2. candidates who use the financial statements of SMEs (investors and lenders).

The SMEIG is chaired by IASB member Zach Gast. All members of the SMEIG serve on a voluntary basis. The SMEIG also includes appointed observers who have the right to participate in SMEIG deliberations, but not to vote.

Terms of appointment

Successful candidates will be appointed for a term of three years, which may be renewed for a further three-year term.

Apply

Nominations and applications must explain the candidate’s knowledge of and experience with financial reporting by SMEs and may include any relevant supporting information.

Nominations and applications will be considered if they are received by 28 September 2026.

IASB have the discretion to review applications received after the specified date.

About us

At the IFRS Foundation, we believe better information leads to better decisions. We set financial reporting standards that enable companies to meet the evolving information needs of the global capital markets. United by our purpose to foster trust, growth and long-term financial stability in the global economy, we engage in challenging, meaningful work every day—across all our areas of expertise.

If you share our passion for this mission, we want to hear from you.

Diverse perspectives. International expertise.

Working for our global organisation offers many benefits, including:

  • rewarding work that serves the public interest;
  • engagement with diverse international experts;
  • inclusive and collaborative teams;
  • intellectually challenging projects;
  • flexible working arrangements;
  • numerous areas of specialisation; and
  • opportunities for professional growth and development.

Diversity and inclusion are seen as key strengths of our organisation. These qualities are essential for us to engage with and meet the needs of our varied global stakeholders, and they are part of what makes the IFRS Foundation a great place to work.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Come join the largest baking company in the world and our family of 20,000 associates nationwide!

Annual Bonus Eligibility
Comprehensive Benefits Package

Position Summary:

The Senior Analyst, Inventory Control is responsible for managing end-to-end inventory control processes, operational reporting, and supply chain analytics. The role supports daily inventory operations while leading data analysis, system support, and continuous improvement initiatives that drive business performance. As a key contributor to supply chain projects and strategic solutions, the position delivers actionable insights and supports effective inventory management across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee accurate and adequate warehouse transaction management (receiving, shipping, repacking/kitting) and inventory performance management (cycle counting, adjustments, OS&D) to ensure inventory is accurate, and Order to Cash (OTC) process is effectively managed.
  • Ensure internal inventory records are synchronized with 3PL warehouse records. Review, validate, and address 3PL warehouse errors by identifying root causes and leading, implementing, and monitoring performance improvement or recovery action plans.
  • Manage inventory controls, track and report performance, and provide insights and data driven analytics to capitalize on continuous improvement opportunities to drive profitability, productivity, and operational effectiveness.
Supply Chain Operational Duties (60%):
  • Inbound PO (Purchase Order) management: receiving inbound POs timely in Oracle, ensuring accuracy and appropriate supporting documentation is provided.
  • Manage inventory transaction reconciliation between 3pl and Oracle inventories
  • Ensure timely and accurate warehouse shipment confirmations
  • DRC (Display Ready Case) management: Manage inventory transaction reconciliation between open-stock master cases and DRCs.
  • Work cross-functionally with Demand Planning, Transportation, Customer, Service, Distribution, teams to ensure end-to-end inventory management/control process is defined and controls are implemented.
  • Liaison with 3PL (third party logistics provider) to ensure compliance with requirements
Supply Chain Reporting (20%):
  • The role also owns several critical reports that support cross-functional teams and serve as key tools for business decision-making and operational oversight
PO to Invoice management (20%)
  • Manage three-way invoice match exceptions and partner with Accounts Payable and co-manufacturers to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely payment.
QFS (Quality Food Safety) and Customer Support (as needed)
  • Co- lead traceability activities the distribution team, as required
  • Implement internal modifications to continuously improve QFS process.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Self-Awareness: Seeks and applies feedback to build on strengths and address development opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Builds strong partnerships and works effectively with others to achieve shared goals.
  • Drive for Results: Embraces challenges and new opportunities with urgency, energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Business Acumen: Demonstrates an understanding of the business environment and adapts effectively to organizational culture and ways of working.

Education and Work History:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required in supply chain or business-related field
  • 3-5 years working experience
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and multitasking abilities.
  • Working knowledge of consumer-packaged goods (CPG), food manufacturing, and supply chain operations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, data analysis, and reporting.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards to support business decision-making.
  • Experience leveraging AI and Microsoft Copilot tools to improve productivity, automate tasks, and generate business insights.

About Us:

At BCD Meetings & Events (BCD M&E), we provide more than meeting and event planning services: we create connections that inspire, motivate and change behavior for our customers. As the world’s most trusted and innovative meetings and events agency, BCD M&E cultivates a culture of people, passion and purpose to drive business forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, with locations in 60+ countries across the world, BCD M&E’s team of 2,000+ people are committed to sustainability and driving success for our customers, our business and ourselves. Our values are at the heart of everything we do, and we look for people that want to be a part of something special, can rise to our standards and love to bring their unique perspective to the table.

While we can’t guarantee every day will be the best (who can?), we can promise a community of people who genuinely care and lead with empathy, a flexible workplace with awesome perks and challenging work that means something.

See what life is about at BCD M&E at

About the Role

If you enjoy improving how meetings programs run at a global level, this role is for you. As the Global Meetings Program and Technology Manager, you will help lead the day-to-day success of a global meetings program with a strong focus on meetings technology, contracting, process improvement, and operational efficiency.

In this role, you’ll support and optimize the meetings technology experience, currently Groupize, while partnering closely with client stakeholders and sourcing teams across regions. You’ll take a consultative approach to understand current workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, create standard operating procedures (SOPs), and help drive more consistent, scalable ways of working.

This role also requires strong experience in contract review and negotiation, along with the ability to turn reporting and program data into meaningful business insights and recommendations. You’ll work closely with a Europe-based Global Travel Manager, so your schedule will need to align across GMT and PT time zones (6:00 AM – 3:00 PM PT).

What You'll Do

  • Manage and support key elements of a global meetings program, with a focus on operational consistency and user adoption

  • Serve as a subject matter resource for the meetings technology platform, currently Groupize, including day-to-day support, issue resolution, and process guidance

  • Partner with client administrators and sourcing teams to understand how they use the system today and recommend improvements

  • Create and maintain SOPs, training materials, and process documentation to support program users and promote best practices

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, simplify processes, and drive efficiencies across meetings operations

  • Review, negotiate, and support meeting and event contracts, with a strong understanding of risk, supplier terms, and business requirements

  • Support venue sourcing and supplier engagement as needed

  • Analyze multiple reports and data sources to deliver clear, relevant business insights and program recommendations

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across regions and time zones to keep program priorities moving forward

You’re Good At

  • Managing global meetings programs, meetings operations, or event technology tools

  • Creating SOPs, improving processes, and driving operational efficiencies

  • Reviewing and negotiating contracts for meetings and events

  • Taking a consultative approach to understand stakeholder needs and recommend practical solutions

  • Working hands-on with meetings technology platforms, ideally Groupize

  • Training users, supporting adoption, and communicating clearly with stakeholders

  • Using data and reporting to identify trends, evaluate performance, and support business decisions

  • Balancing strategic improvement work with day-to-day program execution

You Might Also Have

  • Experience supporting a global meetings technology platform in an administrative or power-user capacity

  • Familiarity with meetings, travel, sourcing, and supplier management processes

  • Experience working with client-facing teams in a consultative or advisory role

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort reviewing multiple reports to provide meaningful business insights

  • Experience working with global stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones

  • HCP or Life Sciences planning experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot

  • Ability to work remotely

Ready to help shape the future of global meetings with BCD M&E? Apply now!

THE PERKS

Flexible Working
We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow
Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

Everyone has a voice
We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected.

Make your move
The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move.

We’ve got you covered
Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.
It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways.

Travel requirements for this role are as follows:Less than 25%

We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Client Technology Solutions Specialist is between $70,000 - $82,000. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience, geographical location, and project budget.

raw.description:
About Lucent Health

Lucent Health combines top-tier claims management with a compassionate, human-focused, data-driven care management solution. This approach helps self-insured employers provide care management that enables health plan participants to make smarter, cost-saving healthcare decisions. Continuous data analytics offer ongoing insights, ensuring participants receive the right care, at the right cost, at the right time. Join us as we build a company that aims to be a better health benefits partner for self-insured employers.

Company Culture

We believe that the success of Lucent Health relies on having employees who are honest, ethical and hardworking. These values are the foundation of Lucent Health.

Honest

  • Transparent Communication: be open and clear in all interactions without withholding crucial information
  • Integrity: ensure accuracy in reporting, work outputs and any tasks assigned
  • Truthfulness: provide honest feedback and report any issues or challenges as they arise
  • Trustworthiness: build andmaintaintrust by consistentlydemonstratingreliable behavior

Ethical

  • Fair Decision Making: ensure all actions and decisions respect company policies and values
  • Accountability: own up to mistakes and take responsibility for rectifying them
  • Respect: treat colleagues, clients and partners with fairness and dignity
  • Confidentiality: safeguard sensitive information and avoid conflicts of interest

Hardworking

  • Consistency: meet or exceed deadlines,maintaininghighproductivitylevels
  • Proactiveness: take initiative to tackle challenges without waiting to be asked
  • Willingness: voluntarily offer toassistinadditionalprojects or tasks when needed
  • Adaptability: work efficiently under pressure or in changing environments

Summary

The Manager of Large Case Management is responsible for the overall leadership, strategy, and performance of the Large Case Management (LCM) function. This role oversees clinical operations for high-cost and complex medical cases, ensuring quality member outcomes, regulatory compliance, and financial stewardship. The Manager leads Supervisors and case management staff, drives operational excellence, and partners cross-functionally to optimize care delivery and cost containment strategies. This role is accountable for program development, vendor strategy, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance clinical and financial outcomes. The Manager reports to the Director of Case Management and may require intermittent travel.

Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the Large Case Management program, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and clinical best practices.
  • Oversee daily operations through direct leadership of Supervisors, ensuring productivity, quality, timeliness, and documentation standards are met.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs),identifying trends and implementing action plans to improve outcomes and efficiency.
  • Lead the development and execution of case management strategies for high-cost and complex cases to optimize clinical outcomes and financial impact.
  • Support Case Management vendor strategy, performance monitoring, and evaluation ofreferral appropriateness and outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with all accreditation, regulatory, and contractual requirements (e.g., state, federal, URAC, NCQA, HIPAA).
  • Partner with Finance and leadership to ensure accuracy, integrity, and insights within stop loss reporting and high-cost claim analysis.
  • Lead internal and external audits, quality assurance initiatives, and regulatory readiness efforts.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Utilization Management, Claims, Network, and Client Services to drive coordinated care and program effectiveness.

raw.title: Engineering Manager
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Senior Domain Architect, Data Management, is a key technical advisor within Workiva’s Data Management Practice. This role supports customers and partners through onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Workiva solutions, applying expertise in data management, integration, and automation to drive long-term value. Acting as a bridge between Sales, Engineering, and Customer & Partner Experience teams, the Architect helps organizations realize the full potential of the Workiva platform while staying aligned with broader technology solutions.

The Senior Domain Architect engages directly with customers and partners, including at executive levels, to design and deliver scalable data management solutions. By fostering strong relationships, sharing best practices, and guiding adoption, the Architect ensures reliable, efficient outcomes that strengthen customer success and long-term value with Workiva.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with customers to understand their business needs, data requirements, and desired outcomes with Workiva solutions.

  • Partner with the pre-sales team to facilitate a seamless transition from the sales process to implementation services engagements and beyond

  • Engage with Solution Architects and Customer Success teams to ensure a cohesive and positive customer experience throughout onboarding and implementation

  • Gather feedback from customer and partner interactions and share insights with Product Development and Product Management.

  • Drive customer and partner success by fostering product adoption, ensuring satisfaction, and contributing to overall customer health

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Partner Experience teams to define expected outcomes and demonstrate the value realized by customers and partners

  • Accurately document new and existing data management features and functionalities for internal and external reference.

  • Proactively monitor customer and partner environments, staying informed about the Workiva product roadmap to provide effective support and guidance

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field of study, preferably Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar

  • 6+ years of related career experience in customer-facing roles, preferably Technical Customer Success, Solution Architecture, or Consulting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python for scripting and automation

  • Experience integrating or managing SaaS applications and enterprise systems, particularly within Accounting, Finance, Audit, Risk & Compliance, or Sustainability

  • Experience integrating with or managing ERP (e.g., Oracle, Workday, SAP, Sage), EPM (e.g., Oracle, Planful, Anaplan), and enterprise data/analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Power BI)

  • Strong problem-solving and technical diagnostic skills.

  • Proven ability to build credibility, influence stakeholders, and drive cross-functional alignment

  • Demonstrated commitment to customer success and long-term value creation

Travel Requirements and Working Conditions

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Workiva is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that great minds think differently. raw.description:
About Kitsch

Kitsch is a certified female and minority-owned global beauty brand. Our products are in 32,000+ retailers across 92 countries. We make everyday essentials that make you feel exceptional.

The Role

We ship thousands of orders every day through Shopify, TikTok Shop, and Faire. We need someone who keeps that flow moving, no matter what.

This is a fully remote role, and you're our eyes on ShipHero, our warehouse management system. While our floor team in Los Angeles picks, packs, and ships, you watch the system behind them: every order in a fulfillable state, every queue moving, every problem caught before it becomes one. You treat every stuck order like it's your job to fix it.

Location: Remote, Philippines or Latin America
Workplace Type: Remote
Compensation: To be discussed

What You'll Do

Keep orders flowing

  • Own the daily health of our online orders, from the moment they land in ShipHero to the moment they ship
  • Watch how we're pacing against the day's orders and flag it early if we start falling behind
  • Keep an eye on our oldest, most urgent orders and make sure they ship first
  • Make sure every order is ready to fulfill: correctly statused, allocated, and visible to the right team

Keep the systems honest

  • Monitor ShipHero daily: order statuses, queues, batches, and the settings that keep our workflows enforced
  • Troubleshoot the real issue, not just the symptom: fix automation rules, reprocess orders, track down why an order landed in the wrong place
  • Catch problems before they happen: watch for the patterns that come before a stall, like orders missing shipping methods, allocation failures, or inventory that needs to move
  • Pull reports from ShipHero to answer real questions: what's aging, what's blocked, what shipped

Speak up and help the team improve

  • Escalate fast and to the right person when something needs hands on the floor, like low inventory or product that needs to move into pickable locations
  • Suggest process changes that would make us more efficient. You see the whole system all day; tell us what to fix

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • Hands-on ShipHero experience required
  • 2-4 years in e-commerce fulfillment, WMS administration, or 3PL operations
  • A systems thinker: when one order breaks, you check what else broke the same way
  • Calm under pressure. Peak days and product launches energize you, they don't rattle you
  • A natural fixer. You ask "how can I help?" before anyone asks you to
  • Strong spoken and written English; you communicate clearly and proactively — including live, when something urgent needs to be escalated — with a team you don't share a room with
  • Comfortable working hours that overlap with our Los Angeles warehouse day

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop, or Faire, and how their orders flow into a WMS
  • Experience working with or inside a 3PL
  • Bilingual English/Spanish

Title: Ambassador/Influencer Manager

Department: Marketing

Location: Remote

About CoinPoker

Welcome to CoinPoker, the innovative crypto-poker platform where advanced blockchain technology meets the thrilling world of online poker. At CoinPoker, we are revolutionizing the poker experience by offering fast, secure, and transparent gameplay. With recent substantial investment, we are poised to take over the online crypto-poker space and are expanding our team to support our growth.

The Opportunity

The Ambassador Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management, optimisation, and performance of assigned ambassador, influencer, streamer, and creator partnerships.

The role is focused on ensuring partners deliver what has been agreed, partner content is reviewed and improved in real time, promotional campaigns are executed properly, performance issues are identified and addressed quickly, and the partner roster grows through the sourcing and onboarding of new ambassadors, streamers, and creators.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for assigned ambassadors, influencers, streamers, and creator partners, managing communication, feedback, and performance-focused partner management.

  • Source and evaluate new ambassador, streamer, and creator opportunities, supporting negotiation and onboarding through to launch.

  • Track partner deliverables, campaign activity, and posting schedules, ensuring partners meet contractual obligations, and review partner content in real time across relevant platforms.

  • Develop and coordinate promotional campaigns for partner audiences, working closely with the CRM, marketing, PRM, and affiliate teams.

  • Coordinate with partners to brief and collect content assets required for campaigns and promotional activity.

  • Submit monthly partner performance reports and end-of-month invoice reviews, flagging missed or incomplete deliverables to management.

  • Support partner renewals and new ambassador launches, and mentor Junior Ambassador Managers.

  • Monitor high-performing creator content and engagement trends across the industry, sharing findings with the team.

Highly Desired Knowledge and Experience:

  • Strong understanding of poker rules, terminology, and community dynamics.

  • Proven experience managing influencer, streamer, ambassador, or creator relationships from onboarding to monthly execution.

  • Exceptional project management and organisational skills, with a track record of tracking complex deliverables, schedules, and campaign activity simultaneously.

  • High level of accuracy when auditing partner content, verifying promotional compliance, tracking deliverables, and reviewing monthly invoices.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Natural ability or experience in guiding, mentoring, and supporting junior team members.

  • Ability to analyse campaign activity and audience engagement metrics to optimise partner content and evaluate campaign effectiveness.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in the blockchain and online gaming industry.

  • Flexible working hours and the ability to work fully remotely.

  • A collaborative and inclusive team culture.

  • Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
  • Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
  • Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
  • Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
  • Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager, to manage, assist and consult our customers on the DACH market and ensure a strong long term relationship. You will handle customer cycles from onboarding to renewal, and be able to have a clear impact on how we manage our customers now and going forward.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 400 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

You will join our current team of three in Customer Success to work on serving our German-speaking customers. As an early member of the team, you will be able to have an instant impact on the customer experience.

This is a full-cycle CSM position, which means you will handle everything from onboarding to renewal. This means we’re looking for someone who is passionate about strong customer relations, but ideally also with a knack for teaching. When it comes to contracts and numbers, you’ll be working closely with our account executives to ensure we find the best fit for our customers.

As the team is young, we hope that you will also want to be a part of shaping the processes and future of CS at Pandektes.

What you’ll do

  • Onboarding customers - Teach lawyers and legal professionals how AI can superpower their legal research

  • Drive adoption - Collaborate with management/executives to ensure adoption and success

  • Build community - Find superusers and empower them to do even more with Pandektes

  • Foster growth - Identify expansion opportunities and work with the rest of our team to expand our presence at existing customers

What you’ll bring

  • Fluency in German and English

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by creating good relationships, top-notch customer experience and driving growth as part of our commercial team

  • 2+ years of experience in customer success

  • Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

  • Eagerness to learn and openness to feedback; you value insights from others and use them to grow

  • Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

  • Strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for AI (basic knowledge of AI and LLMs is a plus)

  • Willingness to develop deep knowledge of how lawyers work and conduct legal research (a legal background is an advantage but not required)

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, London and Zurich.

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

What we offer

  • A central role in a fast-growing company with €4M+ raised, most recently a €2.9M seed led by People Ventures and Interface Capital

  • International team events - last time we went to Barcelona, and we'd love to have you join us next time 🌍

  • Flexible work - from the office or home 🏡

  • We take work-life balance seriously and well-being is one of our values

  • 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

  • Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses 💳

  • Paid parental leave

Client Director – New Business

Purpose

We are seeking an experienced New Business Client Director to represent and sell our world-class service offerings. This is a true net-new logo role: pipeline is self-generated, not inherited. The ideal candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, a proven track record of sales excellence, the ability to meet and exceed quotas, and a history of new account acquisition. The candidate has a passion for “hunting” new customers, is comfortable prospecting cold into accounts with no prior relationship and has extensive experience selling to the “C” level. Must be hungry and have a passion for winning.

The New Business Client Director role requires experience consulting mid-market and Enterprise customers on technology strategy with a focus on delivering business outcomes. This role will need experience selling into the mid-market and Enterprise customer segment ($100M–$1B in revenue). The New Business Client Director will have experience selling with a consultative approach rather than product fulfillment and is able to establish credibility with executive decision makers and IT leadership — typically without the benefit of brand pull, inbound demand, or BDR-fed leads.

We need someone that can be very hands-on, do whatever it takes to build revenue, and be a strategic thinker with the ability to create long-term sales plans and execute on them for our prospects. The New Business Client Director candidate should possess sound business acumen, strong technical aptitude, a comprehensive in-market network, and significant sales experience that will be vital to helping to develop new opportunities and drive revenue. This individual contributor role will be focused on planning, prospecting and pipeline development, opportunity qualification, deal positioning and closing to overachieve individual sales targets.

This position offers a competitive base salary, uncapped commissions, and the opportunity to sell highly differentiated Cloud/IT solutions. The successful candidate will be able to show examples of their own sales success and achievements by way of exceeding sales quotas, documented new-logo wins, and personal recognition through sales awards or acknowledgments.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, this position can be remotely based out of U.S or Canada.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Generate net new sales revenue through a consultative and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Leverage existing Sales tools to accurately forecast, track and modify sales funnel, regularly and with consistency
  • Manage a base of 3-5 key clients won or transitioned into your name and be responsible for driving a pre-determined level of revenue growth, overseeing the overall client relationship strategy of that base — while net-new logo acquisition remains the primary focus of the role.
  • Gain referrals via an extensive personal network to drive additional increased business for the organization
  • Participate in the development, presentation, and sales of a value proposition.

  • Self-source the majority of pipeline through disciplined outbound prospecting, cold outreach, industry networking, and events — without relying on inbound demand, BDR hand-offs, or channel-fed leads.

  • Stay in total engagement with the account during the sales cycle while bringing in additional necessary resources from the Sales, Product, Client Success, and Practice-based teams.
  • Collaborate with Chief Information Officers (CIO), Chief Financial Officers (CFO), IT Directors, ERP Management
  • Teams and other IT professionals to develop plans for IT optimization and cost control/reduction.
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations largely through managed services relationships, IT project work and staff augmentation.
  • Experience in delivering business outcomes leveraging technology. In this role, the New Business Client Director will be expected to understand the business of the prospect and map Centrilogic’s platform back to the clients initiatives.

  • Enterprise/ERP Cloud Strategies,
  • JD Edwards, EBS, NetSuite and Peoplesoft Support (CNC, Report-Writing, Development, Functional Helpdesk,Migrations & Upgrades, Sys Admin)
  • Database Administration/Management (remote DBA) for Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, IBM DB2, and MySQL.

raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.

Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions

  • Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation

  • Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy

  • Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance

  • Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements

  • Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations

  • Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users

  • Lead business analysis activities for medium to large-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation

  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels

  • Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies

  • Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences

  • Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision-making, and the ability to influence without authority

  • Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows

  • A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry

  • Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives

  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows

  • Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)

  • Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)

  • Training in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)

  • Background in implementing or optimizing clinical data management processes

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and facilitating decision-making

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

raw.title: Lead Rover Navigation and Perception Engineer
raw.excerpt: Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company.  We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon.
raw.description:
Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon. We are focused on the problems that must be solved before the next chapter of human exploration can scale. The Moon does not forgive untested assumptions. The people who work here know that, and they wouldn't have it any other way.

The Lead Rover Navigation and Perception Engineer will be responsible for the design, tuning, analysis, and characterization of the navigation and perception system for Astrolab’s extra-terrestrial rovers. The Lead Rover Navigation and Perception Engineer will work closely with the flight software team to implement and test all of the rover navigation and perception algorithms. This position is a technical leadership position with an expectation that the lead will also be doing hands on work as part of the rover guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) team to design, characterize, and test the vehicle navigation and perception system. The Lead Rover Navigation and Perception Engineer will devise test campaigns to be executed with real hardware in simulated and analog lunar environments and work with the team to execute the tests.

Note: Some travel may be required for this position

What you'll do:

  • Lead a small team of engineers to design, characterize, test, verify, and validate localization and perception systems for extra-terrestrial rovers
  • Bring a navigation and perception solution from early design through flight operations on an aggressive schedule for Astrolab’s CLV-1 lunar rover
  • Work closely with the software team to implement and test navigation, perception, and obstacle avoidance flight software
  • Ensure that extra-terrestrial rover navigation and perception solutions are robust, upgradable during flight, and practical
  • Devise, supervise, and execute navigation and perception system testing with real sensors and flight computers using a test vehicle operating in simulated lunar conditions
  • Ensure that navigation and perception system meet performance and NASA human rated spacecraft system requirements

What you'll bring:

Basic Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 10+ years designing, developing, and testing navigation, localization, and perception systems for rovers, autonomous vehicles, GPS-denied vehicle navigation systems, or similar autonomous or robotic platforms.
  • Experience with practical sensor fusion and Kalman filtering for wheeled vehicle navigation and perception, with specific experience using sensors with widely different modalities to determine robust navigation and perception solutions (e.g. IMU, lidar, radar, star tracker, etc.)
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience designing, tuning, developing, analyzing, characterizing, verifying, and validating navigation and perception solutions for wheeled vehicles
  • Experience developing, testing, and characterizing obstacle detection and avoidance algorithms for wheeled vehicles
  • Experience dealing with real world issues that affect navigation/localization/perception system design and performance, such as invalid data, dropped packets, data latencies, blurry images, and similar
  • Experience supporting a navigation/localization system through the entire lifecycle, from early design through live vehicle operations
  • Experience in C++ and Python programming

Benefits and Perks

  • Join a team of best-in-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration
  • Equity ownership in the company
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health support
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • Home office set up reimbursement
  • Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on-site
  • Once a month social hour on-site with food and drinks
